I’m a System Engineer at Computacenter, focused on ML engineering and MLOps. In my free time, I work on open-source ML research and engineering.

My open-source work ↗ J.O.S.I.E. models ↗

Open source

I’m a key contributor to Apple’s MLX and MLX-LM, adding training features and model support for local AI on Apple Silicon. I added the Muon optimizer and ReLU² activation to MLX, contributed model architectures and training workflows to MLX-LM, and maintain the trainer backend for MLX-VLM.

Research & models

My research includes DynaMoE on adaptive expert activation, Gabliteration on model editing, and DLPO on latent preference optimization.

J.O.S.I.E. is my open model family. J.O.S.I.E.-2 explores reasoning, honesty and independent judgment in 2B, 4B and 9B models trained on Apple Silicon. Browse the models · Read the research note
